title: held_by_process has a suite test, a Windows run with the cwd in a subdirectory, and tidy lists a held worktree as kept
goal: A suite test runs release_worker_worktree's unchecked branch (refuse, and put back after the rename probe), a recorded Windows run covers a process whose working directory is a subdirectory of the worktree, a failed rename-back leaves the registration pointing at an existing path or says so, and bl_land.tidy_worktree_kept reports a held worktree as kept instead of would remove; found by the SP-kjqdiudr review (BG-nlp5aat5).
